mentions.note: aged 15, won Surrey Schools 400m in personal best 51.6; selected for English Schools
won Surrey Youths 400m in championship best 49.9
won Surrey Youths 400m in CBP 49.9 and 800m in CBP 1.56.9
Surrey County Youths Award for his Surrey 400m record
